title: FleetForge v2.7.0 Enterprise IT Edition
changelog: Official Release v2.7.0 Enterprise IT Edition with 100% QA certification
Unified common search box with automatic live Microsoft Winget cloud package integration in the main catalog table
Seamless continuous list displaying local packages first and live online packages appended cleanly without clutter or separator banners
Automatic Display Resolution & UI Scaling Engine for small screens and laptops (720p, 768p, 1080p, 4K)
User Display Zoom Settings with Auto, 100%, 90%, and 80% responsive presets
Eliminated redundant pagination and prompt buttons for an ultra-clean, streamlined user interface
Comprehensive Enterprise QA Automation Suite with 100% Sandbox pass rate across 64 tests
